no_changes.title: No Changes
no_changes.detail: You have not changed anything. The project cannot be released.

schematic_review.title: Schematic Review
schematic_review.detail: Have someone review the schematics before proceeding.

fix_issues.title: Fix Issues
fix_issues.detail: Resolve the issues found during schematic review before proceeding.

no_pcb.title: No PCB Changes
no_pcb.detail: You have not made required edits to the PCB.

finish_files.title: Finish Files
finish_files.detail: Please finish modifying the files before proceeding.

export_nc_drill.title: Export NC Drill
export_nc_drill.detail: Please export the NC drill files before proceeding.

pcb_needs_edits.question: Does the PCB need edits?
pcb_needs_edits.help: E.g. a new component, changed footprint, or new routing. Schematic formatting changes wouldn't.

pcb_been_edited_2.question: Have you updated the PCB?
pcb_been_edited_2.help: Please make the required changes to the PCB

files_finished.question: Have you finished modifying the files?
files_finished.help: This includes the schematic, PCB and BOM, all saved to server with no local edits.

inc_version.question: Increment the version number.
inc_version.help: This applies accross all subsheets. If this is the first release, use 1.0

changelogs.question: Changelog
changelogs.help: Update the changelog with a description of the changes made.

drop_approval.question: Approval Removals
drop_approval.help: Remove all approvals from modified documents. Unmodified documents do not need re-approving.

review_process.question: Has someone reviewed the schematics?
review_process.help: The schematics cannot be reviewed by someone who was involved in the design process.

issue_check.question: Did the schematic pass review without issues?
issue_check.help: If there were issues, they must be resolved before proceeding.

add_approval.question: Add Approval
add_approval.help: Add the new approval to the modified documents.

generate_exports.question: Generate Exports
generate_exports.help: Export the schematics, PCBs (manufacturing files), BOMs, ordering instructions and any other relevant information

remember_nc_drill.question: Did you remember to export the NC drill files?

update_github.question: Update Github
update_github.help: Add a new folder to the relevant release repository, with the exported files.

result.title: Your next actions
result.intro: Please complete the following actions (if any).
